title: Inventory and deliver positively selected deterministic capabilities
description:
Own deterministic capability work under ADR 0020. A capability is a positive narrow
commitment, not evidence about the whole source corpus. Maintain a truthful inventory of
selected capabilities and a separate bounded legacy backlog. Unbound/unclassified/backlog
entries never prove source absence or completeness.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every deterministic capability in force has one authoritative positive contract and real runtime binding.
- Capability identity/revision/operation and exclusions are stable and provider-neutral.
- Execution/state evidence proves the selected operation, not the enclosing record or corpus.
- Legacy engine:F1-F10 membership is a bounded magic-item backlog/candidate set, not a source-mechanics census.
- No capability ledger claims zero unowned/unimplemented mechanics outside the positively selected set.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
